name: ue-tools
description: Unofficial Unreal Editor Remote Control for Cursor agents, plus optional GitHub source search for users who already have Unreal Engine access. Not affiliated with Epic Games.

GITHUB_TOKEN.title: GitHub token
GITHUB_TOKEN.description: PAT that can read the configured Unreal Engine GitHub repo (default EpicGames/UnrealEngine). Optional if you only use Editor Remote Control. Alias of GH_TOKEN.

GH_TOKEN.title: GitHub token (alias)
GH_TOKEN.description: Accepted alias for GITHUB_TOKEN. Set one of the two for source search.

UE_REMOTE_CONTROL_URL.title: Unreal Remote Control URL
UE_REMOTE_CONTROL_URL.description: Base URL of a running Unreal Editor Web Remote Control HTTP server on your machine or lab. Default http://127.0.0.1:30010.

UE_OWNER.title: GitHub owner
UE_OWNER.description: Override source repo owner. Default EpicGames. Use a private-fork owner when you are not using EpicGames/UnrealEngine.

UE_REPO.title: GitHub repo
UE_REPO.description: Override source repo name. Default UnrealEngine.

UE_REF.title: Git ref
UE_REF.description: Override source git ref (branch, tag, or SHA). Default release.
